review.judgment:
Both images were inspected. Text has strong contrast and no visible clipping or overlap. Hierarchy is clear, but excessive desktop whitespace and vague workshop instructions weaken the story rhythm and usefulness.
capture-1792319256117-1440.png: Scene 1 clearly separates title and preparation text. Scene 2 has a strong accent rule but little supporting content. Scene 3 is the weakest page: its centered heading and single sentence leave most of the canvas empty and provide no comparison criteria. Scene 4 repeats scene 1's arrangement without showing how to record observations. All four pages have readable contrast and no visible clipping or overlap; oversized empty areas slow the sequence.
capture-1792319256117-390.png: Scene 1 stacks cleanly, with natural body wrapping. Scene 2 preserves clear hierarchy and its accent rule. Scene 3's larger heading fits, but the instruction does not explain what to compare. Scene 4 remains legible but offers no recording structure. No visible clipping or overlap; mobile spacing is substantially tighter than desktop, though the procedural story remains underdeveloped.
